reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows low friction and wear for (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 on steel at room temperature and high load, supporting tribofilm formation and tribocatalysis. However, it provides no data on CoCrFeNi substrates, elevated temperatures up to 800 °C, or varying loads, leaving the high-temperature and substrate-specific premises unsupported.
premises: Spray-coated (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 forms a lubricious tribofilm during sliding
The tribofilm achieves low friction (COF <0.1) and low wear
Tribocatalytic activity generates and regenerates the lubricious phase
Performance is maintained from room temperature to 800 °C
The coating works on a CoCrFeNi substrate under varying loads and ambient atmosphere
